Project Description:
The Gandikota Pumped Storage project is located in Kondapuram village of YSR district of Andhra Pradesh, India.

The project envisages utilization of available head between proposed upper dam on adjacent hilltop and existing Gandikota reservoir as lower pond. An Underground Power House (UGPH) to be located in between two reservoirs. Both the reservoirs will be interconnected through water conductor system and the generator and turbines installed at the power house.

The Full Reservoir Level (FRL) of existing Gandikota reservoir (Lower Reservoir) is at El. 212m and Dead Storage level at El.202.9m. An artificial Reservoir is proposed as Upper Reservoir which is constructed as bund type Reservoir at Elevation-El. 462.0m with a proposed bund height of 20 m to store 9.52 MCM water required for peaking generation. The proposed project will generate 1000 MW of power by utilizing net design head of 258.41 m.

Project Description: Singanamala Pumped Storage Project (SPSP) is an Off-Stream Closed Loop Pumped Storage development, proposed with an installed capacity of 800MW/5248 MWH. The Project comprises of development of upper & lower reservoirs with a gross storage capacity of 0.73TMC & 0.59 TMC respectively, out of which upper reservoir to be constructed on the hilltop with maximum dam height of 54m to create the desired storage capacity while the lower reservoir will have maximum height of 33 m constructed at the downhill. The one-time filling of the PSP reservoir will be carried out from Chagallu Barrage, which is about 10.50 Kms from the PSP lower reservoir. The scheme of operation for the project is with 6.56 Hours of peak power per day and 7.20 Hours for pumping back the water to the upper reservoir. However, as the proposed project is a pumped storage project, no consumptive utilisation of water is envisaged, except for recouping the evaporation losses of 0.968 M Cum in the upper & lower reservoirs.

Project Description: The Pulicat lake is the second largest brackish water lagoon in India, spreading across the Tamil Nadu-Andhra Pradesh border. Evaporation losses, if any will be recouped periodically.

Feed (Agricultural residue) is crushed and sent to a pre-treatment reactor. Pre-treated feed is sent to hydrolysis reactor. Hydrolyzed products are sent for fermentation to produce ethanol. Project Description:
Visakhapatnam Port Authority(VPA) formerly Visakhapatnam Port Trust(VPT) commissioned VFH in the year 1976 and it is under the control of Department of Fisheries of Govt of Andhra Pradesh(DoF–AP). The VFH area admeasure about 24 ha of land. The existing structures includes 5 fishing jetties, 6 auction sheds and 1 Net mending hall,etc,. The VFH is designed to handle berthing and landing of fishing vessels with a total wharf length(incl. jetties) of 1300 meter. The VFH provides separate office space to the exporters, close to the wharf, in the form of Exporters Procurement Centre.
In October 2014, A severe cyclone Hud Hud hit the Visakhapatnam coast. The fishing Harbour faced devastation with an estimated 60 nos of mechanized boats sunk into the sea and about 250 boats are partially damaged. The cyclone also damaged the common harbour infrastructure such as wharf wall, roof of exporters procurement centre, jetties etc. As per EU and FAO norms, the VFH required infrastructure development.

Project Description: The project is mainly non-molasses distillery based on lignocellulosic biomass (mainly rice straw/corn stover) ethanol production of 3 KLPD and Compressed BioGos plant of 150 MTPD in on area of 55 acres at Denduluru, Eluru district of Andhra Pradesh as a greenfield project. Feed (Agricultural residue) is crushed and sent to a pre-treatment reactor. Pre-treated feed is sent to hydrolysis reactor. Hydrolyzed products are sent for fermentation to produce ethanol. Ethanol from fermented liquid is separated and purified by distillation followed by dehydration. The method of generation of methane gas is through anaerobic digestion using the crushed agricultural residue by hydrolysis, acido and Acetogenesis and Methanogenesis with the help of inoculums/onaerobic bacteria.

forest area. It operates on a daily cycle, storing surplus electricity during off-peak hours and 
generating clean power during peak demand periods. The scheme requires a net storage of 
about 13.10 million cubic metres of water per cycle.

Project Description:
The proposed activity involves conducting Soil Exploration (Geotechnical Investigation) within the designated forest area. This exploration is a mandatory component of the Final Location Survey (FLS) for the new Broad Gauge Railway Line project from Kothagudem to Kirandul (153 km) under South Central Railway.
The scope of work requires drilling temporary boreholes to extract soil and rock samples for laboratory testing. This data is necessary to determine the safe bearing capacity of the soil, finalize the track alignment, and prepare the engineering inputs for the Detailed Project Report (DPR).
All soil exploration tasks are temporary and localized. Operations will be executed with zero permanent construction and will strictly follow environmental guidelines to ensure no trees are felled and the impact on the surrounding forest is kept to an absolute minimum.

Project Description:
The Gandikota Pumped Storage project envisages utilization of available head between proposed upper dam on adjacent hilltop and existing Gandikota reservoir as lower pond. An Underground Power House (UGPH) to be located in between two reservoirs. Both the reservoirs will be interconnected through water conductor system and the generator and turbines installed at the power house.

The Project is located in Kondapuram village of YSR district of Andhra Pradesh, India. The Full Reservoir Level of existing Gandikota reservoir (Lower Reservoir) is at El. 212m and Dead Storage level at El.202.9m. An artificial Reservoir is proposed as upper Reservoir which is constructed as bund type Reservoir at Elevation-462.0m with a proposed bund height of 20 m to store 9.52 MCM water required for peaking generation. The proposed project will generate 1000 MW of power by utilizing net design head of 258.41 m.
